suite_context: hangs when preceded by tests/test_gui_b9.py (8 MainWindow instances)
stack_evidence: logs/hang-stack-exit.txt: faulthandler frame npsc_gui/help_popover.py:192/200 in ContextHelpButton.eventFilter; dump truncated by Qt segfault
root_cause: ContextHelpButton installs an application-wide QApplication event filter (help_popover.py:125). Each live MainWindow adds many such filters; stylesheet re-polish in apply_design dispatches events through all filters, producing superlinear growth and eventual hang. MainWindow construction itself is ~0.5s each due to VersionHistory._load_all, but is not the blocker.
proposed_fix: Remove stale app-wide event filters on widget teardown (or scope filters to the parent window) before calling setStyleSheet; do not exclude the test.
